title: Do a physical count
text: This records the stock you actually have on hand. When you save, the system updates inventory to match your count.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Inventory Count.
Click New Inventory Count.
Click each item on the left to add it, or scan its barcode.
On the right, enter the counted quantity.
Click Save. The count posts and updates stock.

title: Count one section at a time
text: Filter the list first, then use Add All to bring in only that section. Anything not added stays unchanged.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Inventory Count.
Click New Inventory Count.
Filter the left panel by category or shelf.
Click Add All. The items in that section move to the right.
Enter the counted quantities and click Save.

title: Save a count as a draft and finish later
text: A draft saves your counted numbers without changing stock. You can stop and finish the count later.
steps: While counting, click Save as Draft.
To continue later, click Sidebar > Inventory, then Inventory Count.
Drafts are marked with a Draft badge in the list.
Click the arrow at the end of the row, then Edit Inventory Count.
Finish the remaining quantities, then click Save to post the count.

title: Post a count
text: Once you save the count, it is posted and cannot be edited. Check every number before you finish.
steps: Open the count and review each quantity on the right.
Fix any mistake by typing the correct number.
Click Save. Stock updates, and the row shows Posted.
If you need to change it after posting, use a Stock Adjustment instead.

title: Restore a count you changed by mistake
text: Restore Counts returns the right panel to the last saved version so you can start again.
steps: In the count editor, click Restore Counts in the panel toolbar.
Confirm the reset. Unsaved numbers are cleared.
Enter the counts again and click Save.

title: Count items with a barcode scan
text: You can scan an item barcode to add it to the count quickly and save time during a large stock take.
steps: Open Inventory Count and start a new count.
Scan the item barcode or click the item in the list.
Enter the counted quantity on the right.
Repeat for each item, then click Save.

title: Review past counts
text: Each posted count shows the quantity you entered and the quantity the system expected, so you can compare the difference.
steps: Click Sidebar > Inventory, then Inventory Count.
Search by reference number or choose a period.
Click the arrow at the end of a row, then View Inventory Count.
Click Print & Export to print or export the list.
